_comment: SHADOW MANIFEST — deliberately NOT under desks/.
Scope corrected 2026-08-26 after categorising both feeds in full.
Neither feed carries a single Joint Staff (/js/) or English (/en/) item,
so this manifest no longer claims either. What the feeds actually carry is
declared per feed below, by measured counts.
file anywhere under desks/ would make sync_desk_config() write a Japan desk
and source into the tracked production database on the next migration run,
which would put a non-collecting desk into public counts. It lives here so
production discovery cannot see it by accident, and a test asserts that
Nothing in this file is read by pipeline.py. Only the shadow runner reads
it, and the shadow runner writes only to the shadow state branch.

institutions.notes: The Japanese-language estate of the Ministry of Defense and the Self-Defense Forces. The Joint Staff (統合幕僚監部) publishes separately under /js/ and is NOT carried by either feed here.
Publishes separately from the ministry's own pages. Not carried by either RSS feed collected here, and its own index is challenged.

sources.display_name: 防衛省・自衛隊 — news feed (Japanese)
declared_scope: The ministry's Japanese-language news stream. NOT an English press-release feed.
Measured 2026-08-26, 142 items: /j/press/ 105, /j/approach/ 37.
Item types: 134 HTML, 8 PDF.
Joint Staff (/js/) items: 0. English (/en/) items: 0.

sources.display_name: 防衛省・自衛隊 — site update feed (Japanese)
declared_scope: A whole-site update stream, NOT a press-release feed. It reports any page
the ministry publishes or revises, across every section of the site.
Measured 2026-08-26, 391 items: /j/press/ 126, /j/budget/ 93,
/j/profile/ 76, /j/approach/ 63, /j/policy/ 21, /j/presiding/ 11, /j/kids/ 1.
Item types: 342 HTML, 49 directory or other URLs, 0 PDF.
Joint Staff (/js/) items: 0. English (/en/) items: 0.
Because the stream is site-wide, every stored record carries the URL family
it came from. Nothing is filtered out: a budget page and a press release are
both preserved, and labelled as what they are.

sources.display_name: 統合幕僚監部 Joint Staff — press releases (English)
declared_scope: Declared so the Joint Staff stays distinguishable from the ministry's own
Japanese estate. NOT collected and NOT reachable: the index is served behind
an interactive challenge (403), and no RSS route for it is known.
No item from this source has ever been collected.
Declared so the English estate stays distinguishable from the Japanese one.
NOT collected and NOT reachable: served behind an interactive challenge (403).

access_notes: Access qualified 2026-08-26, one honest request per endpoint.
robots.txt: 200, disallows only /a/ and /sp/j/ — every path used here is permitted.
HTML documents: 403 with Cf-Mitigated: challenge, on /j/, /en/ and /js/ alike.
Consequence, measured across news.xml: 8 of 142 items (6%) are PDF and carry
full text; 134 of 142 (94%) are HTML and are recorded as titled, dated
discovery records with no body. This is partial retrieval, not coverage.
The challenge is not solved, worked around, or retried.
